d: Deep purple, short, choppy hair with uneven bangs and a messy texture frames a youthful, mature face with sharp, glowing crimson eyes. The build is slender and athletic, dressed in a white, black, and red stylized combat outfit consisting of a cropped top, a layered pleated skirt with red accents, and asymmetric black thigh-high boots with red soles. Accessories include a black choker, black fingerless gloves, a black shoulder guard on the left arm, and a utility belt with a black pouch.
